environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) in us-east-1 VPC running Tomcat 9.0.41 with the legacy monolith WAR. Instance has public IP via Elastic IP. Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF attached. IMDSv1 enabled (default). Instance role has S3 read access and SSM permissions. Application is accessed directly via http://<elastic-ip>:8080/api/v1/import/catalog
